npm.method: latest published version of each package; production dependencies only; dev, optional, and peer dependencies are not walked; bundled dependencies stay inside the parent's unpacked size; deduped by package name Packages with no dist.unpackedSize use the sum of file sizes in the published tarball.

maven.method: jar Content-Length from Maven Central; compile and runtime dependencies; test, provided, optional, and BOM imports excluded; versions from spring-boot-dependencies 3.5.0 when a POM omits one; deduped by group:artifact. springdoc 2.8.16 is the latest 2.8 release (3.x targets Spring Boot 4).

crocket_binary.note: Measured 2026-11-23 from the Release link of this page's program. The dynamic libstdc++ is not inside the binary.
